root.name: Philidor Defense: Nimzowitsch Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Nf6

overview: Black counterattacks e4 with 3...Nf6 and White chooses between 4.Nc3 (the main line, with ...Nbd7 and the Hanham set-up) and 4.dxe5 Nxe4 (Sokolsky, Rellstab). In the main line White holds a small space edge and Black builds ...Nbd7, ...Be7, ...c6 and ...O-O, then plays ...exd4 or ...d5 when ready. Positions are solid and slightly cramped for Black, with some tactical traps.

white_ideas.idea: Play Nc3 and Bc4 with a space advantage and a pawn centre.
Use dxe5 and Qd5 ideas to tempt Black into traps.

black_ideas.idea: Set up the Hanham with ...Nbd7, ...Be7, ...c6 and ...O-O.
Free the position with ...exd4 or ...d5 at the right moment.

typical_structures.structure: Hanham: Black pawns on d6/e5/c6 against White's d4/e4 centre.

character.notes: Compact, passive but hard-to-break Black structure in the 4.Nc3 main line.

gambit.notes: No material offered in the main line.

soundness.notes: Sound; White keeps a small edge.

structure.notes: Centre in tension (d4 vs e5), unresolved.

approach.notes: Rarely played by top players but a recognised defence.

level.notes: Plans clear for Black but cramped; moderate move-order knowledge.

sublines_that_differ.name: Rellstab Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Nf6 4. dxe5 Nxe4 5. Qd5
sublines_that_differ.how: Sharper, with queen sorties and quick tactics.

character.reason: Compact Black set-up in the main line, passive but hard to break.

approach.reason: Respectable defence even if less common at the top.

plans.reason: White's central space against Black's cramped set-up.
